title: Quadratic Lebesgue points of a bounded operator field for a measure finite on an open set
statement: Let n, l be natural numbers, mu a measure on R^(n+l), O an open set with mu(O) < infinity, and g : R^(n+l) -> L(R^(n+l), R^(n+l)) mu-a.e. strongly measurable with operator norm ||g(w)|| <= C for every w. Then for mu-a.e. y in O, mu(B_s(y))^-1 times the integral over B_s(y) of hsNormSq(g(w) - g(y)) dmu(w) tends to 0 in [0, infinity] as s -> 0+ (B_s(y) closed balls; hsNormSq the squared Hilbert–Schmidt norm).
lean_statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Amb n ℓ)) (O : Set (Amb n ℓ)), IsOpen O → μ O < ⊤ → ∀ (g : Amb n ℓ → (Amb n ℓ →L[ℝ] Amb n ℓ)) (C : ℝ), AEStronglyMeasurable g μ → (∀ w, ‖g w‖ ≤ C) → ∀ᵐ y ∂μ, y ∈ O → Tendsto (fun s : ℝ => (μ (closedBall y s))⁻¹ * ∫⁻ w in closedBall y s, ENNReal.ofReal (hsNormSq (g w - g y)) ∂μ) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 0)
